--- title: "Predicting NBA home wins without leaking the future" subtitle: "Rolling team efficiency and Elo, evaluated in time order" toc: false --- ::: {.cell} ::: This project predicts whether the home team wins an NBA regular-season game, using only information available before tip-off. Models are trained on 2001-02 through 2024-25 and tested once on the 2025-26 season (1,215 games). Predictions for the current season are logged daily before each game; see [Live 2026-27](live.qmd). ::: {.grid} ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
68.6%
Holdout accuracy, ridge with rolling features + Elo
::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
67.9%
Elo ratings alone
::: ::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
55.4%
Always picking the home team
::: ::: The full model beats always picking the home team by a wide margin, but Elo ratings alone get most of the way there. The 95% bootstrap interval for the AUC gain from adding rolling features to Elo is -0.002 to 0.015, which includes zero. ![](figures/model_comparison.png) ![](figures/validation_auc_by_season.png) ![](figures/home_advantage.png) ## All models on the holdout ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} |Model | Accuracy| Accuracy 95% CI| AUC| Brier| |:--------------------------------|--------:|---------------:|-----:|-----:| |Ridge: rolling + Elo | 0.686| 0.662-0.712| 0.738| 0.205| |Elastic net: rolling + Elo | 0.686| 0.660-0.712| 0.737| 0.205| |Gradient boosting: rolling + Elo | 0.682| 0.656-0.709| 0.733| 0.207| |Logistic: Elo only | 0.679| 0.651-0.706| 0.731| 0.208| |Ridge: rolling | 0.664| 0.638-0.691| 0.712| 0.214| |Neural net (MLP): rolling + Elo | 0.653| 0.627-0.679| 0.709| 0.222| |Logistic: lean rolling | 0.642| 0.615-0.670| 0.683| 0.223| |Majority (home win rate) | 0.554| 0.526-0.583| -| 0.248| ::: ::: Code and data pipeline: [nba-modeling](https://github.com/kalebcoleman/nba-modeling) and [nba-data](https://github.com/kalebcoleman/nba-data).
